rows.rationale: Retains Cyrus’s sweeping royal claim and ends with the source’s invitation to go up, leaving the return ahead.
rows.before: “Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: The LORD, the God of the heavens, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has appointed me to build for him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you from all his people— may the LORD his God be with him. Let him go up!”
rows.after: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has appointed me to build him a house in Jerusalem, in Judah. Whoever among you belongs to his people—may the LORD his God be with him, and let him go up!’”
rows.tsw_comparator: “Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: The LORD, the God of the heavens, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has appointed me to build for him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you from all his people— may the LORD his God be with him. Let him go up!”
